g.text: Contextual representatives; none passes BH FDR < 0.05
U1-U2: upstream context; D1-D3: minimum downstream steps
D3 paths to 13 recurrent query hits
All model edges among displayed nodes are retained
Display threshold >=4/14 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=4/14
Node size and x/14 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D3 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
